text: In a short exact sequence 0 → A →f B →g C → 0, exactness at B means:
choices: f and g are both injective
explanation: Exactness at each spot equates the incoming image with the outgoing kernel; at the ends it forces f injective and g surjective. B ≅ A ⊕ C holds only for SPLIT exact sequences — 0 → ℤ →×2 ℤ → ℤ/2ℤ → 0 is exact but not split.
